Suspected Chinese-speaking operators exploited ownCloud CVE-2023-49105 to steal nuclear material records, research reactor data, personnel files, and encryption key material from Philippine nuclear research agency. Concrete incident with CVE, victim, and data types identified.

CVE-2023-49105.evidence: Hunt.io discovered exposed stolen files on Amsterdam server (31.58.209[.]241:8000) on Aug 13 2026, registered to CGI Global Limited. Chinese-speaking operators used the flaw to exfiltrate nuclear records.

decisions.reason: Microsoft fix for Windows 11 gaming crashes caused by RGB peripheral drivers (inpoutx64.sys). Not a security vulnerability, just a bug fix for game compatibility issues.
Webinar promotion for September 23 event about Google Workspace breaches. Marketing content, not a current security event.

ShinyHunters published 50GB of data from 12.9M Carhartt accounts after failed $3.3M ransom demand. Major breach confirmed by Have I Been Pwned founder Troy Hunt analyzing the archive. Includes customer PII, employee data, and corporate documents.
CISA added CVE-2026-8452 to KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation. Federal agencies required to apply mitigations by August 29, 2026. Active exploitation confirmed.

CVE-2026-8452.evidence: CISA added to KEV catalog August 26 2026 after confirming active exploitation. Federal civilian agencies required to patch by August 29, 2026.

decisions.reason: AFP arrested two men (ages 21 and 23) from Western Australia connected to TeamPCP supply chain attack group. Group ran longest software supply chain attack spree, using Shai-Hulud worm to inject malicious code into open source projects.
